reasons: Invalid format specifier '%J' used in the output file option ('-o'). Flux uses '{{id}}' or '{{jobid}}' to represent the Job ID.
Invalid format specifier '%J' used in the error file option ('-e'). Flux uses '{{id}}' or '{{jobid}}' to represent the Job ID.
issues: The job requests 4 tasks (#FLUX -n 4), but the subsequent 'matlab' command is executed as a single process. Unless the Matlab function 'runMoCap_AA_AA_4()' is internally parallelized to use multiple threads (e.g., with the Parallel Computing Toolbox), the additional 3 cores will remain idle, leading to inefficient resource utilization.

#!/bin/bash
 
#SBATCH -p serial                   # Send this job to the serial partition
#SBATCH -n 4                        # number of cores
#SBATCH -t 0-12:00                  # wall time (D-HH:MM)
#SBATCH -o slurm.%j.out             # STDOUT (%j = JobId)
#SBATCH -e slurm.%j.err             # STDERR (%j = JobId)
#SBATCH --mail-type=END,FAIL        # notifications for job done & fail
#SBATCH --mail-user=sliu104@asu.edu # send-to address

module load gcc/4.9.2
module load matlab/2015b
cd /home/sliu104/MoCapGaussian/
matlab -nodisplay -nosplash -nodesktop -r "runMoCap_AA_AA_4()"
